permissions.label: Open Agents
permissions.description: May open the Agents application at all. The portal shows the Agents menu entry only to holders.

permissions.label: View overview
permissions.description: Overview page: platform stats, agent list and recent activity.

permissions.label: Build agents
permissions.description: Studio and Builder: create, edit, duplicate, import, delete agents; nodes, edges, env vars, skills, files, evals, snippets, private templates, Git export/commit.

permissions.label: View templates
permissions.description: Browse the template gallery and its versions.

permissions.label: Manage RAG
permissions.description: Knowledge bases: create, configure, ingest, documents, chunks, metadata, retrieval tests, API keys, provisioning.

permissions.label: Manage integrations
permissions.description: Model providers and API keys, tools, MCP servers, data-source credentials, storage destinations, Git connections.

permissions.label: View traces
permissions.description: Traces page, trace details and spans.

permissions.label: View monitoring
permissions.description: Monitoring page, eval health, Prometheus metrics.

permissions.label: Manage alerts
permissions.description: Alerts: view, acknowledge, resolve; alert rules and destinations.

permissions.label: Use web apps
permissions.description: Web Apps page: open and run published agent apps (run, stream, human-in-the-loop, saved results, chat history, file inputs).

permissions.label: Run agents
permissions.description: Run and test any agent (Try It, batch run), and invoke agents through MCP and webhook triggers.

permissions.label: Publish agents
permissions.description: Publish/unpublish, publish surfaces and MCP, UCS catalog sync, grants and per-agent access roles.

permissions.label: Run maintenance
permissions.description: Operator maintenance under /internal (upload sweep, storage migration, HITL and KB reconcile, job status, readiness diagnostics).
